review_text: I got balcony safety nets installed here in Mailardevpally, and I'm pretty happy. The installation guys were quick and professional. The quality seems solid, though I'll see how it holds up. I opted for transparent nets; they're barely noticeable! It’s great to have the peace of mind now. 4 stars because I haven’t needed any maintenance yet to give a full 5, but they assured me they use certified materials.
